title: Graphilosophy: Graph-Based Digital Humanities Computing with The Four Books

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a multi-layered knowledge graph framework through a qualitative user study to assess its ability to preserve interpretive plurality, distribute commentary authority, and avoid privileging a single cultural or philosophical interpretation.

Qualitative analysis of the system's handling of untranslatable concepts, phonetic ambiguities, and conceptual asymmetries across languages using a trilingual parallel corpus and contextual semantic embeddings.
